headline: Globale Tessile Company Secretary Kinnari Gosaliya to resign in 2026
hook: Compliance officer departure at Globale Tessile

modes.bear: Departure of compliance personnel creates administrative uncertainty.
modes.bull: Planned exit well in advance ensures ample time for a smooth transition.
modes.simple: A company secretary is leaving their job in late 2026. This is standard paperwork for listed companies and does not change how the business runs.

summary: Globale Tessile Limited has notified the stock exchange that Mrs. Kinnari Gosaliya will step down from her role as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The resignation is scheduled to take effect on December 31, 2026. Retail investors should note that changes in key managerial personnel are routine corporate administrative updates.
whats_next: Appointment of a new company secretary before December 31, 2026
why_it_matters: Routine management change with no direct impact on share price.
